<tree id="unifinder-search-results-tree" flex="1"
                onkeypress="unifinderKeyPress(event)"
                _selectDelay="500"
                enableColumnDrag="true">
            <treecols id="unifinder-search-results-tree-cols">
              <treecol id="unifinder-search-results-tree-col-title"
                       persist="hidden ordinal width"
                       style="flex: 1 auto"
                       closemenu="none"
                       itemproperty="title"
                       data-l10n-id="calendar-event-listing-column-title"/>
              <splitter class="tree-splitter"/>
              <treecol id="unifinder-search-results-tree-col-startdate"
                       persist="hidden ordinal width"
                       style="flex: 1 auto"
                       closemenu="none"
                       itemproperty="startDate"
                       sortDirection="ascending"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The unifinder view sorts first, then emits sort-changed with the selected column and direction. The UI clears every existing sortDirection attribute before setting the new one. The initial start-date column declares ascending; the tree no longer persists a separate sort-active/sort-direction pair. Preserve this local model-to-header contract when changing the event list. A visible indicator check has not run. Static source and test inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending.
title: Keep the unifinder sort indicator tied to the view’s sort event
